header.source: PPM (Röser & Bastian 1991, Bastian & Röser 1993) with the Henry Draper Catalogue, through CDS; star counts from Tycho-2 (ESA), through NASA HEASARC

magnitudes.hd: the Henry Draper catalogue's photovisual magnitude, measured
magnitudes.ppm-pg: PPM's photographic magnitude less its spectral class's usual B−V, then set by its rank so the counts to each tenth are Tycho-2's (ESA)

header.colors: Ptg − Ptm where the Henry Draper catalogue measured both, else the class's usual B−V
